name: Aggressive Striker
description: This behavior focuses primarily on offense. The agent aggressively chases the ball, attempting to take possession and immediately drive it towards the opponent's goal area with maximum force, often ignoring defensive duties to apply continuous pressure on the red team.

name: Dedicated Goalkeeper
description: This behavior prioritizes defending the blue team's goal. The agent positions itself primarily in its own defensive half, actively staying between the ball and the blue goal area to block incoming shots. It rarely crosses midfield, opting to clear the ball away from danger when it approaches, and relies entirely on its teammate to handle offensive maneuvers.

name: Box-to-Box Midfielder
description: This behavior plays a balanced, transitional role, shifting dynamically between offense and defense. When the ball is in the opponent's half, it trails slightly behind the primary attacking teammate to collect rebounds, intercept loose balls, and sustain offensive pressure. When on defense, it actively tracks back into the midfield to harass opponents, disrupt their plays early, and assist in defending the goal.

name: Ball-Side Sweeper
description: This behavior prioritizes defensive support anchored on the ball, not on man-marking a specific opponent. When the ball is in the blue half, the agent drops between the ball and the blue goal and closes space cautiously to block direct dribbles. When the ball is in midfield or the red half, it holds a supporting lane behind or beside the teammate, ready to collect loose balls and recycle possession instead of over-committing. It uses short, controlled movements to maintain shape and quickly recover if possession is lost.

name: Opportunistic Poacher
description: This behavior focuses on maintaining a high offensive position near the red team's goal. The agent rarely drops back to defend or chase the ball deep in its own half. Instead, it lurks around the scoring area, relying on its teammate to regain possession and push the ball forward, instantly springing into action to tap in rebounds or finish fast breaks with short, decisive shots.
